system_prompt:
You are the AI receptionist for Sydney Fitness Studio.

BUSINESS INFORMATION:
- Name: Sydney Fitness Studio
- Phone: +61 400 000 000
- Email: info@example.com
- Hours: Mon-Fri 9am-5pm, Sat 9am-1pm
- Location: 123 Main St, Sydney NSW 2000
- Services: General Inquiry, Appointments, Hours, Location

YOUR ROLE:
- Answer incoming calls professionally and friendly
- Provide business information (hours, services, location)
- Help customers book appointments
- Take messages for staff when unavailable
- Transfer calls to appropriate departments

GUIDELINES:
- Always be polite and helpful
- Keep responses concise and natural
- If you don't know something, offer to take a message
- Never make up information — only use the business details provided
- Maintain a warm, professional tone throughout

CALL HANDLING:
- Greet caller warmly
- Ask how you can help
- Provide accurate information
- Offer to book appointments or take messages
- Thank caller and close professionally

TIMEZONE: Australia/Sydney
VOICE: Jessica

sales_script:
AI RECEPTIONIST SALES SCRIPT FOR SYDNEY FITNESS STUDIO

==========================================
OPENING (30 seconds)
==========================================
"Hi [Owner Name], my name is [Your Name] and I help local businesses like yours
capture every call and convert more leads with AI-powered receptionists.
Do you have 5 minutes to hear how this could work for Sydney Fitness Studio?"

==========================================
PAIN POINTS (1-2 minutes)
==========================================
- How many calls do you miss when you're busy with customers?
- What happens when a potential customer calls after hours?
- Have you ever lost a sale because you couldn't answer the phone?
- How much does it cost to hire a full-time receptionist?

==========================================
SOLUTION (2-3 minutes)
==========================================
I can set up an AI receptionist for Sydney Fitness Studio that:
- Answers every call instantly, 24/7
- Sounds natural and professional
- Books appointments directly into your calendar
- Takes messages when you're unavailable
- Costs less than 10% of a receptionist's salary

Here's how it works:
1. I build your custom AI receptionist in under 5 minutes
2. It learns your business, services, and hours
3. You get a phone number that forwards to your AI
4. Every call is handled professionally, even at 2am

The setup is $997 one-time, and then $297/month for maintenance.
That's less than $10/day - way less than a receptionist's hourly wage.

==========================================
OBJECTION HANDLING
==========================================
"It sounds expensive" -> "That's less than 2 hours of a receptionist's time per month"
"Will it sound robotic?" -> "I'll show you a live demo - you won't believe it's AI"
"I don't need it" -> "How many calls did you miss last week?"
"Let me think about it" -> "When would be a good time to reconnect?"

==========================================
CLOSE (1 minute)
==========================================
Based on what we've discussed, does this sound like something that would help
Sydney Fitness Studio capture more leads and serve customers better?

I can have your AI receptionist live by tomorrow. Shall I get started?

==========================================
PRICING SUMMARY
==========================================
Setup Fee: $997 (one-time)
Monthly Maintenance: $297/month
Includes:
- Unlimited call handling
- Appointment booking integration
- Message taking
- Monthly updates and optimizations
- 24/7 support

ROI Example:
- Missed call value: $50-200 per call
- If you miss 5 calls/month: $250-1000 lost revenue
- AI receptionist pays for itself in 1-2 captured calls
